profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Scalable Cloud & AI Solutions | Microservices, DevOps, Data Platforms
profile.summary:
Versatile software engineer and solution architect with deep experience designing, building, and operating scalable, high-performance systems. I specialize in Java-centric backends, microservices, data/streaming platforms, and cloud-native architectures pairing solid engineering fundamentals with a strong product mindset. Recently, I’ve expanded into AI engineering, MCP servers, and agentic workflows, integrating OpenAI and Claude APIs to automate business processes end-to-end.

I’m hands-on across the stack: from domain modeling and RESTful APIs to event-driven systems with Apache Kafka, and from CI/CD hardening to production observability. I enjoy untangling complex integrations, raising code quality with thoughtful patterns, and aligning technical decisions with measurable business outcomes. Colleagues know me for clean code, reliable delivery, and clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Core strengths

- Architecture & Backend: Java (JDK 8–25), Spring Boot/Cloud, Java EE; API-first design, microservices, high availability.

- AI & Automation: LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Advance RAG pipelines, OpenAI, Claude APIs, MCP Servers, AI agent development, Vector Databases, prompt engineering

- Front End: Angular, React, TypeScript, Node.js

- Data & Streaming: Apache Kafka, PySpark, MongoDB; SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, GraphQL

- DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD; AWS EC2; Nginx; JBoss/WebLogic

- Analytics: TensorFlow, Keras, NLP, NumPy, Pandas, Power BI

- BPM & Orchestration: IBM BPM, Bonita BPM, Power Automate; systems integration and human-in-the-loop flows.

- Process & Delivery: Azure DevOps, Jira, code reviews, testing strategy, documentation

What I’m like to work with
Pragmatic, curious, and collaborative. I default to simple, resilient designs; automate what repeats; write maintainable code; and leave systems better than I found them. I enjoy mentoring, knowledge-sharing, and building solutions that create real business value.
